# Fonts

This mod adds font packages to firefox, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `firefox` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:firefox-fonts
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:firefox-fonts|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/firefox-fonts/
